name: FrenchModelVariant101_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant101_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4, followed by a 16-byte scale constant; for a non-negative request it selects the configuration indexed by the request and packs the texture, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-variant101.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-84/214 and Japanese images build the same source directly, at the same addresses (notes/overlays/usa-model-french-entries.md). Not the US header-101 source model_variant/variant101_entry.c. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
